## TemplateEngine.\_processDescriptionBlocks() method

Extracts and parses `<description>` blocks from a template string.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static _processDescriptionBlocks(template: string): {
        [lang: string]: {
            [scope: string]: string;
        };
    };
```

**Returns:**

{ \[lang: string\]: { \[scope: string\]: string; }; }

A nested object mapping language keys to scopes to their cleaned content

## Remarks

This internal method identifies all `<description>` blocks and extracts their content organized by language and scope. Blocks without a `lang` attribute are stored under `"default"` language, and blocks without a `scope` attribute are stored under `"default"` scope.

## Example


```typescript
const template = `
  <description>Start the bot</description>
  <description lang="id">Mulai bot</description>
  <description scope="chat_administrators">Admin command</description>
`;
const descriptions = TemplateEngine._processDescriptionBlocks(template);
// Result: {
//   default: { default: 'Start the bot', chat_administrators: 'Admin command' },
//   id: { default: 'Mulai bot' }
// }
```
